allocations.hard_ceiling: controller_recovery pass budget <= 600s always; no cumulative ceiling overrides it
allocations.new_allocation: object {grant_s:positive int, granted_by:const tern} within per-pass ceiling; free-form rejected
allocations.recover: duty-only incident pass from BLOCKED; records only
allocations.verifier_events: require integer elapsed_s; spend beyond pass budget rejected

runtime_json.authoritative_decisions: entry decision_ref/reason must equal ledger disposition decision_ref/reason; ledger-silent fields cannot be supplied by the projection (invented -> E_MISMATCH); lifecycle DECIDE requires both
runtime_json.authority_order: shapes/version/revision, then structural faults (duplicates, overdue, terminal kind/ownership/rest fields, successor links, chains), then ledger authority, then exactly one of ACTIVE/REST/pending-ACTION_DUE; authority precedes every valid outcome
runtime_json.flight_receipts: dispatched: receipt equals ledger ack (null/absent ledger receipt is not acknowledged); handoff: receipt equals ledger (None) — forged ack E_MISMATCH and cannot satisfy successor_opened; DECISION: receipt must be acknowledged with matching ledger-open task; no-action: action/owner/deadline/receipt must all be null
runtime_json.flight_rotation: START sets worker flight; PUBLISH clears it and records either verify:{action_id,owner,deadline} or handoff:{owner duty|director, deadline}; both preserved through BLOCKED/resume and replay; publication with neither is E_BAD_ALLOCATION
runtime_json.ledger_authority: ledger determines inventory/phase/disposition/decision/action/owner/deadline/receipt; revision equality necessary not sufficient; missing actives/terminals E_LEDGER_INCOMPLETE; fabricated packages/claims E_FABRICATED; forged phase/disposition/decision/action/owner/ack/deadline E_MISMATCH; row-17 held vetted against ledger task
runtime_json.liveness: a successor link is satisfied only by an in-flight entry with dispatch_receipt==acknowledged AND a finite deadline; anything else is dangling/unrelated

projection_terminal.held?: bool, true only with open bounded director-decision task carried as DECISION in-flight

runtime_json.shape_strictness: package ids and phases are non-empty strings; metadata str-or-None; nested blocker/trigger/decision objects validated before use; duplicate package projection E_DUPLICATE; flight phase must equal ledger phase
runtime_json.timestamps: validated as UTC instants (Z or numeric offset accepted, compared as instants); malformed values are E_MALFORMED, never crashes, never silent REST/ACTIVE

verdict_codes_vs_transition_codes: E_* verdict codes come from the validator; transition rejections use the same registry; INVALID is a validation fault, never a lifecycle terminal
